nodes.summary: England is the country where association football, field hockey, rugby, and cricket were created. The capital of England is London, and it is located in the continent of Europe. The official language of England is English.

nodes.name: Canada
nodes.summary: Canada is the country of citizenship for Alan Thicke, Vic Toews, Maurice Strong, Justin Trudeau, Bryan Adams, Pierre Karl Péladeau, Dirk Nowitzki, René Angélil, and Ferdinand von Richthofen. Shinty was created in Canada, and post-punk music was also created in Canada. The capital of Canada is Ottawa, though one source incorrectly stated it as Königsberg. Canada is located in the continent of North America.

nodes.name: United States of America
